title: Skillet-Style Oven English Muffins
description: Skillet-Style Oven English Muffins made from a small batch of scratch dough.

steps.title: Mix the dough
steps.text: Combine {bf}, {milk}, {butter}, {yeast}, {salt}, {sugar}. Use room-temperature liquids and softened fat. Mix until no dry flour remains.

steps.title: Develop the dough
steps.text: Knead 6–8 minutes until smooth. For wet dough, fold in the bowl with damp hands.

steps.title: Let rise
steps.text: Cover and let rise 45–75 minutes at room temperature until about doubled.

steps.title: Prepare the dusting
steps.text: Spread {cornmeal} on a plate for coating the rounds.

steps.title: Shape
steps.text: Pat to ¾ inch thick and cut six rounds; dust the tops and bottoms with the reserved cornmeal.

steps.title: Proof
steps.text: Cover and proof 30–50 minutes until puffy; a light fingertip dent should return slowly.

steps.title: Heat the oven
steps.text: Preheat the Samsung oven to 400°F on conventional Bake.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake on a dark greased sheet, flipping once halfway for two toasted faces. Fork-split after cooling. Allow 15–20 minutes; verify 195°F at the center of a test piece.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Cool on a rack for 10 minutes under a clean towel for a softer finish.

notes: Make ahead: weigh the dry ingredients the evening before. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: Yes. Cool completely and freeze sliced or individually wrapped for up to 2 months. Fridge reheat: wrap a serving in a damp towel and microwave for 15–25 seconds. Freezer reheat: thaw wrapped, then warm the same way. Serve with soup or gravy for a softer bite. Allow about 1–2 hours for rising and proofing in addition to mixing and baking. Estimated nutrition per serving (1/6 of recipe): 183 kcal, 6.6 g protein, 33.4 g total carbohydrate, 1.8 g fat, 1.6 g fiber, 210 mg sodium.
